state.architecture:
Title: Blog App Test Execution and Bug Fixing Design for Code_Playback
Summary: Architectural design to execute the existing test suite in the Code_Playback folder, identify failing assertions or system bugs, apply targeted code fixes to application modules, and verify test suite green state.
Components:
- [MODIFY] Blog Application Test Suite: Automated test suite within Code_Playback validating API endpoints, models, and UI components. (Responsibilities: Execute automated test assertions across blog functionalities, Report test status, failure stack traces, and regression coverage)
- [MODIFY] Blog Application Backend Modules: Core backend controllers, models, and service logic located in Code_Playback. (Responsibilities: Handle data persistence, API logic, and authentication for the blog application, Ensure compliance with expected test expectations and edge cases)
Data Flow: Test Runner executes assertions against Blog Application Backend Modules. -> Backend Modules process inputs, interact with mock or local data sources, and return responses. -> Test Suite validates response codes, payloads, and state changes against assertion criteria.
Dependencies: Local runtime environment (Node.js/Python/Go depending on Code_Playback setup), Test framework dependencies declared in project configuration
Risks: Missing environment variables or local setup might mimic code bug failures.; Fixing one test failure might introduce side effects and cause regressions in other suites.
Verification Plan: Execute the full test suite within Code_Playback and verify 100% pass rate.; Inspect git diff to confirm changes are clean, modular, and directly related to failing tests.

codeChanges.summary: Updated post creation to return HTTP 201 status code, added request body validation for missing required fields, and added 404 error responses for non-existent post queries.
Corrected pagination math calculation, default parameter values, and draft filter logic.
Add validation for empty title and tags array handling to prevent 500 errors on invalid POST requests.
Ensure 401 status code is correctly set when Authorization header is missing or malformed.
